podcast.title: Chester's Addiction Battle (2017)
podcast.body: In June 2017, Chester Bennington confided in his friend Ryan Schuck about his struggles related to this side project, revealing that he was enduring "an hour by hour battle with addiction" just months before his death. "But in June 2017, he did tell his friend Ryan Schuck of his side project, Dead by Sunrise, and he was suffering, and this is a quote, an hour by hour battle with addiction."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Origin as Snow White Tan
podcast.body: Chester Bennington's side project was initially known as "Snow White Tan," a name that was recognized as a possible reference to David Bowie and his Ziggy Stardust persona, before eventually changing to Dead by Sunrise. "his own side project, which was first called Snow White Tan. Notice the reference to Bowie and Zee Stardust, and then Dead by Sunrise."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Battle with Alcohol
xref.body: Chester Bennington confided in Ryan Shuck, the guitarist from his side project Dead by Sunrise, about his "day-by-day battle with alcohol" through text messages, despite appearing to be in good spirits publicly. "He also spoke to Ryan Schuck, the guitarist in another one of his side projects called Dead by Sunrise. Schuck also had issues with alcohol. Some text messages went back and forth about what Chester described as his day-by-day battle with alcohol."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Creation of Dead by Sunrise
xref.body: Chester initiated his side project, initially named Snow White Tan and later Dead by Sunrise, specifically to accommodate songs he had written that "weren't right for Lincoln Park," collaborating with friends from the bands Julian K and Orgy. "The group began because Chester had written some songs that really weren't right for Lincoln Park."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Creative Break and Side Projects
xref.body: After the intense touring cycle for Meteora, the band collectively requested and took downtime. This period allowed members to rest and "pursue some other projects" (like Chester Bennington's Dead by Sunrise and the Jay-Z collaboration "Collision Course") to revitalize their creative energies. "Besides, it would be good to rest and then maybe pursue some other projects to restore the creative juices."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Members in Dead by Sunrise
xref.body: Friends from the band Julian K were featured as members in Chester Bennington's side project, Dead by Sunrise, contributing to the group's formation. "created this new group featuring some friends from bands called Julian K."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
